title.narrative: Ensuring the targeting of vulnerable women and girls in emergency food distributions

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtAs Sudan heads inexorably towards a major famine-situation, coming on the back of widespread conflict which has exacerbated the already present food insecurity, meeting the nutritional shortfalls of both IDP and non-IDP populations will be primordial. Bearing in mind that women and girls are likely to be disproportionately affected, especially those with specific health issues because they are pregnant, breastfeeding, or responsible for the primary care of many children, there will be a specific requirement to ensure that these women and girls are pre-identified and prioritized for the delivery of agricultural inputs (to be less dependent on aid in the longer term) and have their nutritional situation regularly monitored (in the immediate). Failing to do this will have far-reaching nefarious consequences for the women and girls’ personal development but also on the future development of the country on top of failing women and girls’ fundamental human rightsltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtUN Women intends to work alongside FAO and WFP (both of which have agreed to the partnership) involved in the frontline of the current agricultural inputs and food distribution plan in order to better target and monitor agricultural inputs and food distribution to vulnerable women and girls. It will select the intervention zones after consulting with those Agencies based on need and accessibility. It will work with local partners and provide priority needs assessments, training to key aid workers and nutritional monitoring services.lt/pgtltpgtIn more specific terms, the initiative will focus on four key activity areas: ltbrgt1. Provide advocacy and communication to community members and aid workers on the need to prioritize the selected demographicltbrgt2. Provide capacity building training to food distribution aid workers and those involved in frontline logistics in the target areas so they understand the needs of the prioritized demographicltbrgt3. Pre-identify the vulnerable women and girls in the target areas and communicate the details to the lead aid Agency for the sectorltbrgt4. Provide monitoring to ensure that the pre-identified beneficiaries are receiving adequate agricultural inputs and nutrition and obtain feedback from the individuals and their communities (2-way community feedback mechanism).ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe local partners that have been selected to work with UN Women on this initiative are the ones with the strongest capabilities for working on these issues in the Gedaref and Kassala Stateslt/pgt
